{
  "subtype": "predictive_feature_engineering",
  "focus_variable": "high_goal_achievement",
  "per_column": [
    {"name": "intervention_type", "role": "predictor", "is_predictor": true, "rationale": "The kind of intervention (automation, training, cost restructuring, etc.) is a characteristic of the goal's approach knowable in advance and plausibly correlates with whether it will be highly achieved. Legitimate exogenous predictor."},
    {"name": "action_specificity", "role": "predictor", "is_predictor": true, "rationale": "Whether specific actions are named versus a general approach reflects planning quality, an antecedent trait that plausibly carries predictive signal about achievement. Does not restate or leak the outcome."},
    {"name": "baseline_reference_present", "role": "predictor", "is_predictor": true, "rationale": "Presence of a baseline reference is a plan-quality feature available before the outcome; measurable goals often perform differently. Valid predictor."},
    {"name": "improvement_magnitude", "role": "predictor", "is_predictor": true, "rationale": "The ambition of the targeted improvement (20% vs 25-30% vs <15%) is set at goal definition, outside the achievement outcome, and plausibly affects likelihood of high achievement. Legitimate predictor, though partially related to target_percentage."},
    {"name": "time_horizon", "role": "predictor", "is_predictor": true, "rationale": "Timeframe (quarter, fiscal year, multi-year) is known upfront and plausibly influences achievement odds. Exogenous predictor."},
    {"name": "scope_breadth", "role": "predictor", "is_predictor": true, "rationale": "Organizational scope (company-wide vs team-level) is a structural attribute set before outcome and can correlate with achievement. Valid predictor."},
    {"name": "metric_category_alignment", "role": "predictor", "is_predictor": true, "rationale": "Whether the stated action aligns with the metric being measured is a plan-coherence feature knowable in advance and plausibly predictive. Not a restatement of the outcome."},
    {"name": "technology_enablement", "role": "predictor", "is_predictor": true, "rationale": "Whether technology enables the goal is an approach attribute available upfront that may boost achievement. Legitimate predictor."},
    {"name": "feedback_loop_present", "role": "predictor", "is_predictor": true, "rationale": "Existence of a feedback/monitoring loop is a design feature knowable in advance and plausibly linked to higher achievement. Valid predictor."}
  ],
  "n_predictors": 9,
  "predictive_utility": 0.72,
  "rationale": "All nine added columns are exogenous, plan- and approach-level attributes of a goal that are knowable before the achievement outcome is realized; none restate high_goal_achievement or leak it via a component/deterministic function. As a set they capture distinct dimensions (intervention type, specificity, measurability, ambition, timeframe, scope, alignment, tech, feedback), giving a model meaningful predictive leverage beyond the original operational columns. Utility is strong but not maximal because several are derived from the same description field and some (e.g., improvement_magnitude) overlap with existing target_percentage, limiting independent signal."
}
